name: Kustomer AI
tagline: Kustomer is a CRM-powered customer service platform with AI capabilities including KIQ AI agent, which handles tier-1 support automatically, and AI-suggested responses for agents. It unifies customer data across all channels into a single timeline, helping agents resolve complex issues faster.
